# Trigger catalogue — sprezzature-maps

**Generated by `scripts/build_triggers.py`. Do not hand-edit.** A test asserts this file equals the generated output, so a phrase added here and nowhere else fails CI.

Draws a choropleth or an areas-of-control situation map on real geography — real coastlines, a real projection, a bundled basemap.

## When this skill is the answer

**You are holding:** Numbers attached to PLACES — a column of countries, regions, states, départements.

A phrase list cannot generalise — the ways to ask are unbounded, and a user almost never names the tool. What is bounded is the kind of thing in front of them. Match that first; the phrases below confirm a match, they do not make one.

Said without naming a tool: "which countries are worst affected", "break this down by region", "where is this happening", "who holds the east", « par département »

## When it is not

Not this one when: the shape is schematic rather than geographic (hex map, spike map, binned grid, dot density over an outline), which live in sprezzature-figures. The exhaustive trigger catalogue is in `references/triggers.md`.
